name: overnight-while-paused
about: The overnight run starts while claude's pace holds the queue back (#317). A small weekly budget (claude per_week 20k): one claude build takes the week past it, so claude claims pause for the rest of the week. The approver schedules tonight's run; #b, a P2 build, waits ready but held back by the pace, and #a waits in review. The work the pace holds back cannot be claimed, so the queue is quiet: at 01:00 the runner takes the overnight run (its lanes are no claude runs) and #b still waits. A second night with the pace paused is not needed: the 07:00 note is in overnight-unstarted-note.
